items.name: Ability Shield

items.name: Adrenaline Orb

items.name: Air Balloon

Held: If the holder participated in a trainer battle, the trainer earns twice the usual prize money. This effect applies even if the holder fainted.

items.name: Antidote

Held in battle: When the holder is frozen, it consumes this item to thaw itself.

items.text: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will lessen the damage taken from one supereffective Electric-type attack.

items.name: Water Stone
items.effect: Used on a party Pokémon: Evolves an Eevee into Vaporeon, a Lombre into Ludicolo, a Panpour into Simipour, a Poliwhirl into Poliwrath, a Shellder into Cloyster, or a Staryu into Starmie.
items.text: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is the blue of a pool of clear water.

items.name: Weakness Policy
items.effect: Held: When the holder is hit by a super effective move, its Attack and Special Attack raise by two stages.
items.text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Attack and Sp. Atk sharply increase if the holder is hit with a move it’s weak to.

items.name: Wellspring Mask
items.effect: Ogerpon-Wellspring: 1.2× power attacks; Terastallize to gain Embody Aspect.

items.name: White Herb
items.effect: Held in battle: At the end of each turn, if any of the holder’s stats have a negative stat modifier, the holder consumes this item to remove the modifiers from those stats.
items.text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle. It can be used only once.

items.name: Wide Lens
items.effect: Held: Increases the accuracy of any move the holder uses by 10% (multiplied; i.e. 70% accuracy is increased to 77%).
items.text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of moves.

items.name: Wiki Berry
items.effect: Held in battle: When the holder has 1/2 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to restore 1/8 its max HP. If the holder dislikes dry flavors (i.e., has a nature that lowers Special Attack), it will also become confused.
items.text: If held by a Pokémon, it restores the user’s HP in a pinch, but it will cause confusion if the user hates the taste.

items.name: Wise Glasses
items.effect: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s special moves by 10%.
items.text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This thick pair of glasses slightly boosts the power of special moves.

items.name: X Accuracy
items.effect: Used on a party Pokémon in battle: Raises the target’s accuracy by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.
items.text: An item that sharply boosts the accuracy of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

items.name: X Attack
items.effect: Used on a party Pokémon in battle: Raises the target’s Attack by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.
items.text: An item that sharply boosts the Attack stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

items.name: X Defense
items.effect: Used on a party Pokémon in battle: Raises the target’s Defense by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.
items.text: An item that sharply boosts the Defense stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

items.name: X Sp. Atk
items.effect: Used on a party Pokémon in battle: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.
items.text: An item that sharply boosts the Sp. Atk stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

items.name: X Sp. Def
items.effect: Used on a party Pokémon in battle: Raises the target’s Special Defense by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.
items.text: An item that sharply boosts the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

items.name: X Speed
items.effect: Used on a party Pokémon in battle: Raises the target’s Speed by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.
items.text: An item that sharply boosts the Speed stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

items.name: Yache Berry
items.effect: Held in battle: When the holder would take super-effective Ice-type damage, it consumes this item to halve the amount of damage taken.
items.text: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will lessen the damage taken from one supereffective Ice-type attack.

items.name: Yellow Nectar
items.effect: Changes Oricorio to Pom-Pom Style. Single-use and cannot be used in battle.
items.text: A flower nectar obtained at Melemele Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.

items.name: Zap Plate
items.effect: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Electric moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Electric.
items.text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

items.name: Zinc
items.effect: Used on a party Pokémon: Increases Special Defense effort by 10, but won’t increase it beyond 100. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.
items.text: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the Sp. Def base points of a single Pokémon.

items.name: Zoom Lens
items.effect: Held: Raises the holder’s Accuracy by 20% when it goes last. Ingame description is incorrect.
items.text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder moves after its target moves, its accuracy will be boosted.
